THE GERMAN GAAP TOTAL-COST-METHOD PROBLEM. Kestrel reports on the Gesamtkostenverfahren (nature-of-expense) basis, where the inventory movement is presented as a revenue-side item. The group reports on the cost-of-sales basis, so this account is reclassified into cost of sales with a sign reversal. Getting this wrong overstates both revenue and gross margin. See ADR-0008 and control CTL-MAP-08.
